what did you plant in/ fertilize with?

Shitty yard dirt that's mostly clay covered in some weird layer of dark organic matter that the previous owner put down over the entire back yard for no apparent reason. I used Tomato-Tone organic tomato fertilizer for the most part but when I felt like my plants could use a quick boost (mostly when they were endlessly producing massive amounts of tomatoes and started to look like foliage was suffering) I gave each one a splash of miracle-gro from a watering can. Organic fertilizer needs to be broken down by soil microbes for the plants to use it, but miracle grow is like instant plant steroids, it's just not good to use a lot because it can build up salts in your soil and the manufacturing process isn't very earth friendly.
